scope: Public outline precision only: the two-jet condition belongs to the central nodes of the relative family; smooth fibres themselves have no nodes.

guards.label: series:II:F
guards.old_text:
The actual flat cup kernel on a smoothed
comb imposes a cyclic two-jet condition at each node.
guards.new_text:
The actual flat cup kernel in the comb smoothing family
imposes a cyclic two-jet condition at each central node.

map_updates.old_claim_tex:
The actual flat cup kernel on a smoothed
comb imposes a cyclic two-jet condition at each node. The explicit
conic frame map realizes a dense open set of these quotients;
twelve teeth attain the balanced cohomology. The exact collapse
and semicontinuity maps give $K_{12}=\mathcal O(-8)\oplus\mathcal O(-9)^2$
on the stated open family, and the actual Hodge formula gives
$(h^{1,1},h^{1,2})=(49,48)$
(\hyperref[inv:E2.5]{\ref*{inv:E2.5}},
\hyperref[inv:E2.2]{\ref*{inv:E2.2}}).
